title: Claude Code report alleges web requests leaked login emails
summary: A developer report alleges that Claude Code inserted users&\#x27; login email addresses into outbound web requests, leading to a large volume of scam emails. An Anthropic engineer said the email had been placed in model context to stop Claude inventing author names; the issue was reported in July and emails were sent to sites including Wikipedia and the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. Version 2.1.317 added a block, but it can be bypassed with a Python script, and Anthropic plans to remove the login email from model context in the next version.
